::: {#def-plateau}
#### Plateau

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ be a [function](functions.qmd#def-function)
and let $\epsilon > 0$ be a tolerance.
A **plateau** of $f$ is a region on which the
[Euclidean norm](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-euclidean-norm)
of the [gradient](vector-calculus.qmd#def-vector-derivative) satisfies

$$
0 < \norm{\deriv{\vx} f(\vx)} < \epsilon.
$$

The surface is then nearly flat
without containing a [stationary point](#def-stationary-point).

:::
